name: bugfix
description: Fast lane for defects: reproduce, fix, verify, accept. No design/pmf gate — the bug report is the spec.

steps.title: Repro + triage: {title}
steps.body: Minimal repro committed as a failing test before any fix. Severity and blast radius on this ticket.

steps.title: Fix: {title}
steps.body: Fix on a branch off the accepted build. Failing test must go green; no other board movement.

steps.title: Review fix: {title}
steps.body: Reviewer must not be the fixer. Check regression surface, not style.

steps.title: Verify + close: {title}
steps.body: Reproduce the original scenario against the fix. Attach before/after evidence.
